aboutHeading: One Bathroom at a Time — That's Our Promise
aboutText: At Melbourne Bathroom Company, we specialise solely in bathroom renovations across Melbourne's inner and middle suburbs. What sets us apart is our unwavering commitment: we complete only one bathroom at a time, ensuring your project receives our full attention and the highest standard of craftsmanship. From Hawthorn and Prahran to Essendon, Coburg, and Southbank, we've built a reputation as Melbourne's most exclusive bathroom builder — delivering exceptional results for homeowners who demand nothing less than perfection.
servicesText: From initial design consultation to final finishing touches, we handle every aspect of your bathroom renovation. Our team delivers end-to-end solutions for homes across Melbourne, including Essendon, Hawthorn, Prahran, Brunswick, and South Yarra.

services.title: Full Bathroom Renovations
services.desc: Complete strip-out and rebuild of your entire bathroom, transforming outdated spaces into modern, functional retreats across Melbourne.

services.title: Shower & Bath Installation
services.desc: Expert installation of frameless showers, freestanding baths, and custom shower screens tailored to your bathroom layout and style.

services.title: Vanity & Tiling Work
services.desc: Precision tiling and vanity installation, including floor-to-ceiling tiles, heated towel rails, and custom storage solutions for Melbourne homes.

services.title: Waterproofing & Compliance
services.desc: Fully compliant waterproofing systems meeting Australian Standards, protecting your investment for years to come in every renovation.

services.title: Bathroom Design Consultation
services.desc: Personalised design guidance to help you select fixtures, finishes, and layouts that maximise space and suit your lifestyle perfectly.

services.title: Ensuite & Master Bathrooms
services.desc: Luxury ensuite renovations for Prahran and South Yarra homes, featuring premium fittings, intelligent storage, and spa-inspired finishes.

reviews.text: We renovated our ensuite in Hawthorn and the result was absolutely stunning. Melbourne Bathroom Company only worked on our project, which meant constant attention to detail. The waterproofing, tiling, and fixture installation were all faultless. Could not recommend them more highly.
reviews.name: Sarah Mitchell

reviews.text: Our main bathroom in Essendon was completely outdated. The team gutted it and rebuilt everything — new bath, shower, vanity, and beautiful floor tiles. The fact they only do one job at a time meant no delays and excellent communication throughout the entire process.
reviews.name: James Thornton

reviews.text: As a property manager overseeing apartments in Southbank, I needed a reliable bathroom renovator. Melbourne Bathroom Company delivered a flawless bathroom upgrade on time and within budget. Their exclusive one-bathroom-at-a-time approach really shows in the quality of their work.
reviews.name: Karen O'Brien
